question: Does the ball detector, or the link after it, lose the ball near the goals, where shots happen? (owner, 2026-10-27, lever 1 of the missed-shots diagnosis)
status: descriptive, CPU, written before any measure

measure 1 (hand-verified balls).data: the windows with verified balls and v3 candidates on every frame: M6 2nd f015000 / f037500 (ball_verified/A), M7 1st f030000 and M9 2nd f030000 (ball_verified/v5p2; through src/unseal.py)
measure 1 (hand-verified balls).zone: the verified ball's ground point in pitch metres (release camera): 'near a goal' if within 16.5 m of a goal line (|x| >= 36 m), else 'elsewhere'
measure 1 (hand-verified balls).per zone: frames; any v3 candidate within 12 px (raw, and after the marks / static drops); the top-1 candidate within 12 px; the linked ball (no grass test, as the pipeline now) within 12 px; median ball size in px

measure 2 (labelled shots, all shots cli.proxy: at the labelled shot, within +-0.4 s, a v3 kept candidate (or the linked ball) within one box height of the shooter's feet (truth box) at some players' frame
measure 2 (labelled shots, all shots cli.compared with: the same measure at labelled passes of the same clips
measure 2 (labelled shots, all shots cli.split: shooter within 16.5 m of the goal line or not; per match

reading: if the candidates are there but the link drops them, the lever is the link (CPU); if the candidates are missing, it is the detector (GPU: tiles / retraining)
